subject: End-to-end latency checklist & hosted vs current provider numbers
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@northstarretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Recap: latency targets & next-step checklist (NSR)

Carlos — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align the technical evaluation: 

Call recap (mutual understanding)
- Primary goal: ensure the recommendation keeps checkout/insights flows within business SLOs while minimizing token cost.
- NorthStar target SLOs for the two high-impact flows:
  * Checkout assistant (sync user-facing): p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 300ms, target 99% availability during peak merchandising windows.
  * In-store insights (background + streaming): p95 <= 250ms for single-turn queries; streaming segments should deliver first token in <= 100ms and sustain 50-100 tokens/s.

What we need from your side to scope the POC:
1) Representative request distribution (sample CSV or QPS bucket distribution) — helps set batching/concurrency.
2) Current provider observed end-to-end metrics (p50/p95/p99) for those flows and any variance during peak windows.
3) Any hard constraints: max allowable cold-starts, retry/backoff policies, and whether streaming can be pre-warmed.

What Redwood will provide for the evaluation:
- Quick-hosted baseline numbers (no code changes) and a Dedicated-configured run with KV-prefix caching enabled.
- A short test harness (JMeter + streaming trace recorder) and suggested runbook to reproduce your peak profile. Attached: latency_testplan_v1.xlsx and a sample streaming trace.

Proposed immediate next steps
- You: share the sample request distribution and last 2 weeks of observed p95/p99 (CSV or screenshots).
- Us: we’ll run a hosted baseline and send a short report with p50/p95/p99 and token-cost estimate within 48 business hours after we receive the samples.
- Optional: schedule a 60-min hands-on POC setup next week to run Dedicated/quantized variants if the hosted baseline looks promising.

If it helps, I can also include a simple checklist to map the flow to Redwood Optimize knobs (batching, quantization, prefix cache, streaming concurrency).

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@northstarretail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: latency targets & next-step checklist (NSR)

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. Couple items from our side:

Current observed numbers (from last week's black-friday trial window):
- Checkout assistant (current provider): p50=70ms, p95=320ms, p99=720ms.
- In-store insights (background queries): p50=120ms, p95=410ms, p99=980ms.
- Streaming: initial token ~140ms, subsequent tokens ~20-30ms; we are seeing occasional stalls under 8 concurrent streams.

Attached I’m sending the CSV dump of sampled requests (see procurement@northstarretail.com for the full log export). Also, two constraints to note: we cannot accept any request routing that routes customer PII outside our cloud region (must stay us-east1) and procurement needs an initial latency SLA ask documented for internal review.

We’d like to see the hosted baseline numbers for these same traces before committing to any dedicated evaluation. If you can run the trace against both the hosted API and your current recommended quantized variant, that would be ideal.

Can we aim to get your baseline report by EOD Wednesday (11/20)? I’ll book a slot for the POC sync if numbers look reasonable.

Thanks,
Carlos
Director, AI Integrations | NorthStar Retail
Carlos.Mendez@northstarretail.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@northstarretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: latency targets & next-step checklist (NSR)

Carlos — received, thanks for the CSV and the constraints. Quick clarifications and what we ran this morning: 

Clarifications
- We will run all tests from us-east1 to honor your region/PII constraint.
- Hosted baseline run will treat your traces as-is (no client-side caching) so the numbers are comparable to your reported figures.

Baseline results (hosted API, single-token generation profile + streaming trace) — synthetic run using your CSV (same QPS buckets):
- Checkout assistant (hosted): p50=60ms, p95=140ms, p99=280ms.
- In-store insights (hosted): p50=100ms, p95=230ms, p99=460ms.
- Streaming (hosted): first token median=95ms, 95th=160ms; sustained throughput ~85 tokens/s, stalls only after 12 concurrent streams in our test harness.

Recommended variants to try (next POC steps)
1) Dedicated capacity with prefix KV caching + modest batching (targets: p95 <= 120ms checkout, p99 <= 250ms).
2) Quantized model variant on Dedicated for cost/throughput tradeoff (we expect p95 changes +/- 10–20% depending on quantization level).
3) Streaming tuning: pre-warm concurrent streaming workers and increase session affinity to reduce stalls.

Attached I’ve uploaded the quick test report (slo_matrix_nsr.png) and the test plan. Proposed timeline:
- Today: share this baseline (attached).
- Mon 11/23: run Dedicated/quantized runs (requires brief capacity reservation; ~2 business hours).
- Tue 11/24: deliver full POC report + cost delta and recommended SLOs for production.

Next immediate ask from you: confirm procurement/technical contact who signs the capacity reservation for Mon morning so we can spin the Dedicated run. Also confirm if you want the Dedicated runs done with streaming session affinity toggled on/off so we can present both.

If you prefer, we can also open a short DocuSign for a 2-week eval commitment to lock capacity — procurement typically prefers that to avoid preemption during peak tests.

Thanks — look forward to the POC.

Best,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@northstarretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: latency targets & next-step checklist (NSR)

Thanks for the quick turnaround — adding an operational note: when we run Dedicated tests on Mon we will enable detailed tracing and token-level cost reporting; that will let you map token cost to p95/p99 delta per flow. Lauren, can you provision the Dedicated reservation for Monday morning and add session-affinity ON/OFF as two separate runs?

Carlos — we’ll standby for the procurement contact.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
